scope: conditional two-arm seed-1 pilot after all three TRAIN-only feasibility screens pass

prerequisites.all_seed_screens: screen outputs for seeds 0, 1, and 2 must pass with the current screen implementation fingerprint, registered SW0097 source SHA and exact first-64 ordered IDs; any failed or stale screen closes this pilot
prerequisites.source: strict-load immutable SW0097 seed1 positive_frozen before attaching the opt-in history event membrane
prerequisites.training_order: the exact registered SW0097 seed1 4096-image order, source shuffle seed 118, B16, 256 updates; no warmup or additional images

arms.history_event: same event-driven recurrent core and imagewise RGB binder; binder sees actual emitted gate-times-event traces
arms.gate_only: same event-driven recurrent core and same-initialized binder; binder sees captured continuous gate traces instead of event timing

trainable_and_frozen.trainable_core: all nongraph source-core parameters, including membrane/adaptation parameters
trainable_and_frozen.head: the registered 11-slot temporal binder and shared assignment-mixed RGB decoder
trainable_and_frozen.initialization: both arms start from the same immutable source state and deterministic binder initialization seed 1261; no pretrained head or warmup

optimization.objective: native 128x128 RGB reconstruction MSE only, matching the registered screen; no Q, PLV, density, count, or ground-truth term
optimization.gradient_clipping: clip core and head gradients separately at norm 1.0
optimization.exposures: exactly 256 B16 updates over the 4096 registered IDs once

rollout.gradient_tail: last 64 steps; 960-step no-gradient prefix with recurrent values preserved and detached at the boundary
rollout.static_drive: prepare static graph, drive, and factorized coupling once with gradients enabled before the prefix and reuse for the live tail

prediction_and_evaluation.readout: argmax over binder assignment slots on the 16x16 patch grid; largest assigned group is background; groups smaller than two patches are omitted to background
prediction_and_evaluation.prediction_inputs: actual event traces for history_event; continuous gate traces for gate_only; no validation ground truth during prediction
prediction_and_evaluation.validation: fixed IDs 1320..1639, B8, full T1024 and settled512; save and hash both arms' complete prediction arrays before opening masks; score with the registered three patch metrics
prediction_and_evaluation.anchors: immutable SW0097 seed1 source per-image scores and the preregistered three-seed SW0092 70k Slot means for both IoU thresholds (.20358913115224261 and .20693697915214362)

conditional_seed1_gate.fg_ari: history_event mean must exceed both the matched source97 and gate_only means; paired image bootstrap 95% lower bound must be >0 against each anchor
conditional_seed1_gate.iou: history_event foreground_iou and matched_object_iou must exceed the preregistered three-seed SW0092 70k Slot means (.20358913115224261 and .20693697915214362) by >0.05; do not substitute a seed-1-specific reference
conditional_seed1_gate.bootstrap: 10,000 paired image resamples, fixed RNG seed 126; compare identical sampled image indices for each pair
conditional_seed1_gate.failure: if any registered guard fails, report both arms and close the branch without retuning, expanding seeds, or claiming gate/data-scale causality

provenance.screen_outputs_and_hashes: required in preflight, train manifest, and final pair report
